attribution: Curated by abap-mcp from a fact-checked research corpus (~/docs/reports/abap-mcp-sap-ai-upgrade-2026-09-09/). Class/interface/method SHAPES that mirror SAP-samples/abap-cheat-sheets and SAP-samples/abap-partner-reference-application (both Apache-2.0) are drawn from those repos. help.sap.com and developers.sap.com pages are cited by URL only — no prose from those pages is reproduced here; every string below is this project's own summary.

classes.name: CL_AIC_ISLM_COMPL_API_FACTORY
classes.role: Static entry point for the Completion API. GET( ) returns IF_AIC_ISLM_COMPL_API_FACTORY, whose CREATE_INSTANCE( islm_scenario ) returns IF_AIC_COMPLETION_API — only the intelligent-scenario name is needed since it already carries the connection and model info.

methods.name: GET
methods.purpose: Static factory accessor, no parameters.

methods.name: CREATE_INSTANCE
methods.purpose: IMPORTING islm_scenario, RETURNING IF_AIC_COMPLETION_API, RAISING CX_AIC_API_FACTORY.

classes.name: IF_AIC_COMPLETION_API
classes.role: The completion client bound to one ISLM intelligent-scenario instance; the core object every interaction variant is built on.

methods.name: EXECUTE_FOR_STRING
methods.purpose: Simple string-prompt completion; raises CX_AIC_COMPLETION_API.

methods.name: EXECUTE_FOR_MESSAGES
methods.purpose: Message-container (system/user/assistant/tool-result) completion; raises CX_AIC_COMPLETION_API.

methods.name: CREATE_MESSAGE_CONTAINER
methods.purpose: Build an IF_AIC_MESSAGE_CONTAINER to hold a multi-turn prompt.

methods.name: GET_PARAMETER_SETTER
methods.purpose: Returns IF_AIC_COMPLETION_PARAMETERS (temperature, max tokens, provider passthrough); the setting persists on this API instance across calls.

methods.name: REGISTER_FUNCTION
methods.purpose: Declare one callable tool/function for the function-calling DO-loop pattern.

methods.name: DEFINE_RESPONSE_FORMAT
methods.purpose: Structured-output entry point: define_response_format( )->json_schema( )->from_string( <json-schema-string> ).

methods.name: GET_COMPLETION
methods.purpose: The model's answer text.

methods.name: GET_TOTAL_TOKEN_COUNT
methods.purpose: Prompt + completion tokens for this call (also GET_PROMPT_TOKEN_COUNT / GET_COMPLETION_TOKEN_COUNT).

methods.name: GET_FINISH_REASON
methods.purpose: Normalized stop reason (also GET_ORIGINAL_FINISH_REASON for the provider's raw value).

methods.name: GET_TOOL_CALLS
methods.purpose: Table of IF_AIC_TOOL_CALL when the model requested a function call — empty when it answered directly.

methods.name: GET_RESPONSE_FORMAT_REFUSAL
methods.purpose: True when structured-output generation was refused; initial state means the schema was accepted.

classes.name: IF_AIC_MESSAGE_CONTAINER
classes.role: Holds a multi-turn / multi-role prompt, built via CREATE_MESSAGE_CONTAINER.

methods.name: SET_SYSTEM_ROLE
methods.purpose: IMPORTING system_role — the system-prompt text.

methods.name: ADD_USER_MESSAGE
methods.purpose: IMPORTING message — append a user turn.

methods.name: ADD_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE
methods.purpose: IMPORTING message — append a prior assistant turn (for few-shot / history replay).

methods.name: ADD_TOOL_RESULTS
methods.purpose: IMPORTING the populated tool_calls table (with SET_CALL_RESULT already applied) so the next EXECUTE call can continue the function-calling loop.

methods.name: ADD_USER_MEDIA_MESSAGE
methods.purpose: Returns IF_AIC_MEDIA_MESSAGE for base64 image/media input; ADD_MEDIA must precede its SET_* calls.

classes.name: IF_AIC_COMPLETION_PARAMETERS
classes.role: Returned by GET_PARAMETER_SETTER; bound to (and persists on) one API instance.

methods.name: SET_TEMPERATURE
methods.purpose: String value, must be between 0 and 1.

methods.name: SET_MAXIMUM_TOKENS
methods.purpose: Integer cap on completion tokens.

methods.name: SET_ANY_PARAMETER
methods.purpose: Generic provider-parameter passthrough (name/value); unsupported names can cause a runtime error, booleans must be ABAP_TRUE/ABAP_FALSE.

classes.name: CL_AIC_ISLM_PROMPT_TPL_FACTORY
classes.role: Prompt-library entry point. Only ISLM-defined prompt templates are currently supported. NOTE: there is no CL_AIC_PROMPT_TEMPLATE class in the verified surface — that name is a common but incorrect guess.

methods.name: GET
methods.purpose: Static factory accessor, no parameters.

methods.name: GET_PROMPT
methods.purpose: IMPORTING parameters (name/value pairs matching {ISLM_<name>} placeholders), RETURNING the rendered prompt string; raises CX_AIC_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.

classes.name: CL_AIC_ISLM_ORCH_API_FACTORY
classes.role: Entry point for the Orchestration API — SAP AI Core's Orchestration Service (content filtering, data masking, document grounding) via ISLM, with fewer features than the Completion API.

methods.name: GET
methods.purpose: Static factory accessor, no parameters.

classes.name: IF_AIC_ORCHESTRATION_API
classes.role: Requires an execution-flow template configured in the ISLM model.

methods.name: CONFIGURE_TEMPLATING
methods.purpose: Returns IF_AIC_ORCHESTRATION_SETUP (chainable ADD_USER_MESSAGE / ADD_PROMPT_TEMPLATE).

methods.name: EXECUTE
methods.purpose: Returns IF_AIC_ORCHESTRATION_RESPONSE; read the answer via ->orchestration_result( )->completion( ).

classes.name: CX_AIC_API_FACTORY
classes.role: Raised by CREATE_INSTANCE when the factory cannot build a client for the given intelligent scenario.

classes.name: CX_AIC_COMPLETION_API
classes.role: Raised by EXECUTE_FOR_STRING / EXECUTE_FOR_MESSAGES. Collects HTTP/connection/config errors and LLM/provider errors; carries attribute API_ERROR (IF_AIC_API_ERROR) for the documented error codes. Errors outside the documented codes cause a short dump instead of a catchable exception.

methods.name: GET_CODE
methods.purpose: One of the documented enum constants (see constraints[]).

methods.name: GET_ORIGINAL_CODE
methods.purpose: The provider's raw error code, when different from the normalized one.

methods.name: GET_ORIGINAL_MESSAGE
methods.purpose: The provider's raw error message.

classes.name: CX_AIC_PROMPT_TEMPLATE
classes.role: Raised by the prompt-template factory / GET_PROMPT (per SAP-samples/abap-cheat-sheets; not named on the Prompt Library API help page itself).

classes.name: IF_AIC_ADT_COMPLETION_API
classes.role: Streaming completion surface — incremental deltas for a chat-style UI (e.g. pushed over WebSockets).

methods.name: STREAM_FOR_MESSAGES
methods.purpose: Returns IF_AIC_COMPLETION_STREAM (HAS_NEXT / GET_NEXT -> IF_AIC_COMPLETION_STREAM_PART -> GET_COMPLETION_DELTA / CANCEL / GET_FINAL_RESULTS).

classes.name: IF_AIC_MEDIA_MESSAGE
classes.role: Returned by ADD_USER_MEDIA_MESSAGE for multimodal (image etc.) input; media data must be base64-encoded and ADD_MEDIA must precede the SET_* calls (they act on the most recently added item).

methods.name: ADD_MEDIA
methods.purpose: Register one media item.

methods.name: ADD_TEXT
methods.purpose: Attach text alongside the media item.

methods.name: SET_MEDIA_DATA
methods.purpose: Base64 payload for the most recently added media item.

methods.name: SET_ANY_MEDIA_PARAMETER
methods.purpose: Provider-specific media parameter passthrough.

classes.name: CX_AIQUOTA_ADT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
classes.role: A separate quota exception that must NOT be caught inside ADT IDE actions (per SAP's own catchable-exceptions guidance).

classes.name: TH_AIC_ORCH_API_INJECTOR
classes.role: Test-double injector for the Orchestration API, for unit-testing code that calls it.

classes.name: AIC_MEDIA_TYPE
classes.role: Media-type constants for ADD_MEDIA, e.g. AIC_MEDIA_TYPE=>IMAGE_PNG.

setupSteps: Subscribe to the SAP AI Core service and add the 'extended' service plan in the BTP cockpit (needed for Generative AI Hub / LLM access, not the base plan).
Create an SAP AI Core service instance and a service key — the X.509 service key must be created using the ABAP system's downloaded client default certificate.
Create a communication arrangement for communication scenario SAP_COM_0A69 to connect the ABAP system to SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub — only ONE instance of this scenario can exist per client.
Create the Intelligent Scenario (INTS) — in ABAP Development Tools, or via the 'Intelligent Scenarios' Fiori app / SAP GUI transaction F4469 — and set scenario type 'Generative AI'.
Add an Intelligent Scenario Model (INTM) to the INTS: choose the LLM and version, optionally attach prompt templates.
Publish the INTS. WARNING: once published an intelligent scenario cannot be edited at all; an intelligent scenario model can only have its LLM version and prompt template edited after publishing.

Deploy and activate via the 'Intelligent Scenario Management' Fiori app (or SAP GUI transaction F4470): Deploy, then Activate 'For All'. Allow up to ~5 minutes for sync to the BTP AI Core instance (standard configuration).
Only after activation does CL_AIC_ISLM_COMPL_API_FACTORY=>GET( )->CREATE_INSTANCE( '<scenario name>' ) resolve at runtime — installing this generated class is not enough on its own.
constraints: Temperature must be between 0 and 1 (SET_TEMPERATURE takes a string in that range).
Parameters set via GET_PARAMETER_SETTER persist on that API instance across multiple EXECUTE calls; a separate CREATE_INSTANCE call gets a separate, independent parameter set.
SET_ANY_PARAMETER passes provider-specific parameters straight through; unsupported names can cause a runtime error, and booleans must use ABAP_TRUE/ABAP_FALSE.

Catch CX_AIC_COMPLETION_API and read API_ERROR->GET_CODE( ) (IF_AIC_API_ERROR) for the documented error codes CONTEXT_LENGTH_EXCEEDED, INVALID_PROMPT and CONTENT_FILTER; unknown/programming-error cases raise a short dump instead of a catchable exception.
Do not catch CX_AIQUOTA_ADT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED inside ADT IDE actions.
Debug a failing call via the ABAP Cross Trace in ADT: Window > Show View > Other > ABAP Cross Trace, then enable the 'ABAP Generative AI' and 'SDK' entries in the trace configuration.

LLM output can be a hallucination or a wrong answer — add your own handling; the underlying models are third-party with their own independent lifecycle and can be deprecated or withdrawn at any time, on a release cadence that differs from the ABAP AI SDK's own.
availability: SAP BTP ABAP Environment — no release qualifier stated on SAP's own availability table.
SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition — no release qualifier stated on SAP's own availability table.

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and on-premise SAP S/4HANA — 'as of release 2025 via standard delivery' per a January 2026 SAP-authored community blog; lower releases via Transport-based Correction Instructions, see SAP Note 3513374 (number only — note content is access-gated).

lookalikes.name: AI SDK for SAP ABAP
lookalikes.note: Third-party client for Azure OpenAI — NOT SAP's SDK, does not use ISLM or Generative AI Hub. Self-described as v1.0, supporting only Azure OpenAI API versions 2022-12-01 and 2023-03-15-preview — materially stale as of this curation.

lookalikes.name: Vertex AI SDK for ABAP
lookalikes.note: A component of the 'ABAP SDK for Google Cloud' — NOT SAP's SDK. Calls Google Vertex AI (Gemini text + multimodal) directly; offered at no extra cost beyond Google Cloud usage. Commonly mis-named 'ABAP SDK for Vertex AI' (inverted) in secondary sources.
